text:
Alex T: Quick question: when we route an existing streaming route to v2 in darklaunch, how do we ensure token billing matches v1 semantics (esp. late-arriving tokens from client-side streaming)?
Priya S: Streaming complicates it. If we route to v2 but bill to v1, we must tally tokens as they are emitted, not when connection closes. Otherwise quotas look wrong.
Danielle M: Agree. Solution: emit interim quota increments for partial chunks. On the routing layer, keep a billing session id mapped to v1_quota_key and flush increments per-chunk.
Alex T: Sounds good. Edgecase: client reconnects or resends chunks -> double-counting danger. Need idempotency keys from clients or dedupe at ingress.
Priya S: We can't require clients to change. Better to implement server-side dedupe: maintain recent chunk hashes for 60s window keyed by tenant+session. Low mem cost but prevents dupes.
Danielle M: Also telemetry: expose compat.stream_token_delta = billed_tokens - observed_tokens_by_v2. If delta > 5% raise alert.
Alex T: For function-calls (tooling), v2 may emit more assistant-turn tokens due to structured metadata. Who pays? We should map function-call tokens to the model that executed it (v2) but bill under v1 mapping to keep customer-facing numbers stable. That makes the mapping one-to-many.
Priya S: Right. Mapping table needs to support rules: model_v2 -> v1_model, but also rules for token-type normalization (strip metadata tokens when computing v1-equivalent tokens).
Danielle M: Console UX: for any route with darklaunch enabled show small badge: "Darklaunch (stream-safe)" and a link to a reconciliation view. Hover hint: "Billing shown as v1 for continuity. See reconciliation for token deltas."
Alex T: Auto-rollback rule proposal: if compat.stream_token_delta > 10% for 15m OR compat.error_rate_ratio > 1.5 for 5m then reduce percent by 50% and post incident. Add rollout.action_reason metric for audits.
Priya S: infra-bot: please enforce guardrails on flag changes.
infra-bot: Feature-flag policy enforced: max delta 25% per 10m for streaming routes.
Danielle M: Need a migration checklist in the RFC: mapping table validated, dedupe window configured, telemetry dashboards created, console copy reviewed, and a tenant-preview opt-in flow.
Alex T: Who owns mapping table? Suggest runtime-config (eng-platform) + validation job in model-catalog (mlinfra) that runs nightly and flags unmapped v2 entries.
Priya S: I'll add a job to nightly validator. Also add a small API `POST /mappings/validate` to let product-runbooks run on-demand.
Danielle M: For alerts, propose two Datadog monitors: 1) stream_token_delta > 5% for 10m (warning) and >10% for 5m (critical); 2) dark_accept_rate < 90% for 5m.
Alex T: Small implementation note: avoid split-brain incrementQuota calls. Flow should be: 1) decide route; 2) compute v1_quota_key; 3) reserve tokens locally; 4) actually route. That keeps quota enforcement conservative.
Priya S: Pseudo: ```
session = startBillingSession(tenant, route, v1_key)
for chunk in stream {
  if (!isDuplicate(chunk)) {
    tokens = estimateTokens(chunk)
    session.increment(tokens)
    emitMetric("compat.stream_token_delta", billed-observed)
  }
}
session.commit()
```
Danielle M: Assignments: Priya -> dedupe + validator job; Alex -> auto-rollback thresholds & proto; Danielle -> console copy + reconciliation view mock. I'll own the RFC writeup.
infra-bot: Scheduled: nightly mapping validator job created (ETA 3d).
Alex T: Let's avoid soft-deprec banner fatigue. The console should only show deprecation ETA in tenant-preview mode or explicit subscribe.
Priya S: Agreed. We also need audit logs for each mapping change (who changed mapping, why). Add mapping.audit_log entries.
Danielle M: Cool. I'll sketch the reconciliation UI showing billed vs observed timeseries and a small table of anomalous sessions.
Alex T: OK if I create the RFC and tag infra/devex/SRE?
Priya S: SGTM.
Danielle M: SGTM.
infra-bot: Next sync suggested: 30m RFC review tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
